item.title: RimWorld Prisoner Management Guide — Recruit, Convert & Keep (1.6 & Odyssey)
item.description: Good RimWorld prisoner management turns captured raiders into colonists. Here's the full workflow for the current 1.6 / Odyssey version. Prisoner Setup Cells: 1 bed + 1 door minimum; a comfortable cell boosts recruitment speed. Medical: patch wounds first — healthy prisoners recruit faster. Food: deliver meals manually or via a prisoner stockpile. Security: doors on prisoners, keep weapons out of reach. Recruitment Workflow StepWhat to do 1. CaptureDown raiders, rescue and imprison the useful ones 2.
